```{r}
# Get input and output
source("./pipe.R")
input = pipeline$patients_clustering$input
output = pipeline$patients_clustering$output
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(qs2)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
lung <- qs_read(input$lung)
```



```{r}
p <- DimPlot(object = lung, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 0.1, label = F,group.by = "time.point")
p
```
```{r}
svg(filename = params$data_out_dir %s+% "patients_treatment_UMAP.svg")
p
dev.off()

```

```{r}
p <- DimPlot(object = lung, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 0.1, label = F,group.by = "patient.ident")+ggtitle("")
p
```
```{r}
svg(filename = params$data_out_dir %s+% "patients_idents_UMAP.svg")
p
dev.off()

```
